description: This file contains unit tests for the Allergent class within the OpenMRS core project. It tests allergen creation, property correctness, and comparison methods.

classes.name: AllergenTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior and properties of the Allergen class.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, including loading a dataset and setting a global property.

methods.name: shouldEitherBeCodedOrFreeText
methods.description: Tests that an allergen can be either coded or free text, but not both simultaneously.

methods.name: assertCoded
methods.description: Asserts that the allergen is correctly marked as coded.

methods.name: assertNonCoded
methods.description: Asserts that the allergen is correctly marked as non-coded and contains free text.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldReturnTrueForSameCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that two allergens with the same coded concept are considered the same.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldReturnFalseForDifferentCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that allergens with different coded concepts are considered different.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldReturnTrueForSameNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that allergens with the same non-coded allergen string are considered the same.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldBeCaseInsensitiveForNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Checks that case differences in non-coded allergen strings are ignored when comparing.

methods.name: isSameAllergen_shouldReturnFalseForDifferentNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that different non-coded allergen strings are considered different.
